response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS overall_average FROM event_averages), kept AS (SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.average_amount, ea.average_amount - o.overall_average AS above_overall FROM event_averages AS ea CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ea.average_amount > o.overall_average) SELECT link_to_event, average_amount, above_overall, average_amount - AVG(average_amount) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;
